title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic installation and update of Network Device Interface (NDI) in Teams (MAC)
description: This update now enables users to install and update the Network Device Interface (NDI) automatically in Microsoft Teams on MAC devices without any manual process. This allows organizations to broadcast audio and video streams from Teams instances to a user's local network.
